Mahanadi Steel Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Tamil Nadu · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/10/2016/143 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Pipeline Laying - Tamil Nadu Pkg-143" (water supply), awarded to
 M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 2016-11-04 at a gross executed value of INR 3,14,00,000/- (Rupees 3.14 Crore
 Only). 
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
 completion of the final inspection. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Sunita Joshi. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Mahanadi Steel Corporation
